name: <creature name>
_role: The one claims sheet. Every creature is judged at boss standard: viewed close up, exaggerated, signature thresholds high. Role tiers (minion/NPC/boss) were removed — a cheaper creature is not a different ruler, it is the same ruler with a smaller triangle budget, so adjust tri_budget here if you need one.

claims.label: focal points must not be equal weight
the 8+2 orbit: no in-between azimuth closes into a lump its neighbours are not (outline.py blob flags; see orbit_sheet.png)
the head is visible from every azimuth, reads as its own mass from the front half, and is not small from everywhere (outline.py head_hidden / head_merged / head_small)

read on the PALETTE (albedo before lighting), so the shading stack cannot move it: at least 10% of the view carries a nameable colour (HSV S ≥ 0.30) or the creature reads as a grey mass; at most 50% is LOUD (S ≥ 0.50) or saturation is the base colour, not a spotlight.
